prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1196; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the facts, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was hit.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was pulling out of a parking space in the middle row of a shopping center lot. It was a busy afternoon, and the lanes were crowded with cars looking for spots.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you see before the impact?

A: I was heading toward the exit lane. I checked both ways, saw a gap, and started rolling slowly. Then a silver SUV came around the end of the row much faster than I expected and clipped my rear quarter panel.

Q: Did you have any contact with the other vehicle before that moment?

A: No. I hadn't seen it at all until it was already on me.

Q: After the impact, did you get out of your vehicle?

A: Yes, but I felt a sharp pain in my right knee when I stepped down. I had to hold onto the door for a second.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist because of swelling and trouble bending the knee.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that knee?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago, but I was walking normally before this happened.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and I'd appreciate it if my claim could be reviewed promptly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
